issue.title: Set locale/lang to use UTF-8 in Docker images

repository.name: zaproxy
repository.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project

issue.body:
Change `live`, `stable`, and `weekly` to use `C.UTF-8` for the locale
and lang, to improve interoperability with Python 3 (more specifically
with Click library, used by `zap-cli`).

Close #5818 and close #5632.

issue.title: Dockerized ZAP Proxy throws error when executing zap-cli commands

repository.name: zap-cli
repository.description: A simple tool for interacting with OWASP ZAP from the commandline.

issue.body:
**Start ZAP proxy container:**
```
docker run --detach --name zap -u zap -v "$(pwd)/reports":/zap/reports/:rw -i owasp/zap2docker-stable zap.sh -daemon -host 0.0.0.0 -port 8080 -config api.addrs.addr.name=.* -config api.addrs.addr.regex=true -config api.disablekey=true
```
**Execute zap-cli command in the running container**
```
docker exec zap zap-cli --verbose report -o /zap/reports/owasp-scan-report.html --output-format html
```

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
```
